text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor a-t-t-e-m-p-t-e-d the l-o-g-i-n s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e a-g-a-i-n-s-t the t-a-r-g-e-t a-c-c-o-u-n-t s and left a b-r-u-t-e f-o-o-t-p-r-i-n-t in the s-e-s-s-i-o-n l-o-g s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-a-t-e l-i-m-i-t a-l-e-r-t
2) the actor t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r-r-e-d the g-i-f-t c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e s to t-h-i-r-d p-a-r-t-y m-e-r-c-h-a-n-t s and left a t-r-a-c-t-a-b-l-e c-o-n-v-e-r-s-i-o-n t-r-a-i-l in the p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e r-e-c-e-i-p-t s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the s-u-d-d-e-n s-p-e-n-d r-e-v-i-e-w
3) the actor c-l-o-n-e-d the c-o-o-k-i-e f-i-l-e-s to m-i-m-i-c b-r-o-w-s-e-r f-i-n-g-e-r p-r-i-n-t s and left a d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e d-e-v-i-c-e s-i-g-n-a-t-u-r-e in the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-e-v-i-c-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
4) the actor r-o-t-a-t-e-d the i-p a-d-d-r-e-s s via p-r-o-x-y h-o-p s to h-i-d-e the o-r-i-g-i-n a-l t-r-a-c-e and left a p-a-t-t-e-r-n of p-r-o-x-y j-u-m-p s in the n-e-t-w-o-r-k l-o-g s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the g-e-o l-o-c a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k
5) the actor l-a-b-e-l-e-d the a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y a-s n-o-r-m-a-l s-h-o-p-p-i-n-g in the n-o-t-e s and left a d-i-s-c-r-e-p-a-n-c-y in the b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r a-l-a-r-t s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-r-a-u-d r-e-v-i-e-w
